title: Switch to recent tabs like Alt+Tab
slogan: All your tabs, one key away. Never lose one again.
banner_text: This page is also available in English.
views_label: The switcher, in the view you like
visual_list_text: The list, compact by default, with the tab you used before already selected.
visual_previews_text: A picture of each tab, to find it at a glance.
visual_icons_text: Only the sites' icons, like switching between apps.
visual_details_text: Add the website address, when you last used a tab and its window, when you want them.
visual_only_tabs_text: Turn the toolbar off for the simplest switcher.
features_title: Everything about your tabs, in one place
recent_text: The tab you used before is one tap away. Keep tapping to go further back.
search_text: A few letters find any tab by its title or address.
views_text: A compact list, a grid of previews or of site icons. Pick the one you like.
pages_text: On the browser's own pages too, where extensions can't go, in a small window of its own.
language_text: In 12 languages, right to left included, following your browser's language.
open_text: No account, no ads. The code is on GitHub, under the MIT license.
privacy_text: Better Tab Switcher sends nothing anywhere: no account, no tracking, no network. Your tabs stay in your browser, and the sites you visit can't see which tabs you have open.
ctrl_tab_text: The browser keeps Ctrl+Tab for itself, so the switcher opens with Alt+Y. The guide shows how to change the shortcut, and how to get Ctrl+Tab.
feedback_link: Report a bug or suggest an idea
